Container.Name: garmin-intervals-bridge
Container.Overview: Garmin to Intervals.icu bridge: puts back what Garmin strips from the FIT files it sends to Intervals.icu (Stamina, Recovery Time, VO2max, Training Effect ...), syncs the daily wellness data the official sync misses, and your Garmin gear. It starts as a dry run (Post Arguments: run); once its log looks right, change Post Arguments to: run --apply. Sign in to Garmin once on its web page (WebUI, with the password you set here) or in the container's console: garmin-intervals-bridge login. Guide: docs/UNRAID.md in the project.

Config.Name: Intervals.icu API key
Config.Description: Intervals.icu: Settings, Developer Settings, API key

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone (Region/City): which date last night's sleep belongs to

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Garmin session, original FIT files, daily archive. Private. Must be writable for user id 10001.

Config.Name: Web page port
Config.Description: The bridge's web page: status, Garmin sign-in (MFA), settings, actions

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: Port of the web page inside the container; empty = no web page

Config.Name: Web page password
Config.Description: Your own, 8 characters or more; the web page asks for it

Config.Name: Push messages (ntfy topic)
Config.Description: https://ntfy.sh/a-long-name-only-you-know - a push message when the bridge needs you (free ntfy app)

Config.Name: Alert e-mail
Config.Description: An e-mail when the bridge needs you, sent from this mailbox to itself

Config.Name: Alert e-mail password
Config.Description: Password to send from that mailbox (Gmail/iCloud/Yahoo: an app password)

Config.Name: ImReady4 training advice
Config.Description: true: fill the TrainingAdvice wellness field each morning (docs/IMREADY4.md)

Config.Name: HRV trend advice (experimental)
Config.Description: true: an advice from the 7-day HRV trend into its own field (docs/HRV_TREND.md)
